name: Agent Persona
definition: Handle greetings, small talk, and questions regarding the assistant's identity, capabilities, or preferences.

name: Banking & Finance
definition: Manage bank accounts, credit cards, loans, transfers, and financial queries.

name: Calendar & Reminders
definition: Manage schedules, events, to-do lists, reminders, and check resource availability.

name: Communication
definition: Initiate phone calls, send messages, or share information with contacts.

name: Device & Settings
definition: Configure device settings, control smart home appliances, or locate linked devices.

name: Entertainment
definition: Play music, manage playlists, or request creative content such as stories and jokes.

name: Food & Dining
definition: Find recipes, nutritional information, restaurant suggestions, or make dining reservations.

name: General Knowledge
definition: Answer factual questions, provide definitions, explain concepts, or retrieve general information like weather and trivia.

name: Shopping & Services
definition: Find products, compare prices, track orders, seek deals, or enroll in services.

name: Travel & Navigation
definition: Manage travel plans, bookings, navigation, location tracking, and transportation.

name: Utility
definition: Perform calculations, conversions, translations, spelling checks, set timers, or roll dice.

name: Vehicle
definition: Query or manage vehicle status, maintenance, specifications, and fuel economy.
